verdict.rationale: Rive's homepage says users can 'let an agent generate them with the CLI', which points to an official agent-oriented CLI. The RML docs describe text-based, coding-agent workflows that such a CLI could drive. Beyond that single marketing line, the pack contains no CLI documentation. Missing for 10: CLI docs (install, commands, auth), evidence of how the CLI works with RML or the Editor, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI exists and works.
